name: ecommerce-orders
description: What a shopper committed to, made durable: frozen lines that are never recomputed, a status state machine with no illegal move, creation that is idempotent by unique index rather than by lookup, and an order line published as a contract two later modules are built against.
features: Order lines as a published contract
Line snapshots that are never recomputed
Placement conflict and in-flight told apart
Line accounting for Fulfillment and Returns
